entries.previous: GPU ray queries are available. Hardware-scene failures retain screen-space reflections; allocation fallbacks are recorded in runtime.log.

Screen-space reflections use visible scene depth, not hardware ray tracing. Hardware ray tracing needs a compatible GPU and driver; otherwise screen-space reflections are used. The experimental hardware path traces opaque level geometry; moving racers use screen-space reflections. Off-screen surfaces currently use their vertex colours, not their texture-pack detail. Waterfalls and fountains use a continuous flowing-water material while retaining authored transparency and fog. Hot Top Volcano's lava uses an emissive molten material with the same quality and reflection settings, without water wakes or refraction. These settings do not change collisions, buoyancy or online simulation.
